2609.22005.title: Abstention and Noise Filtering: Two Missing Primitives of Softmax Attention
2609.22005.paper_summary: Gating the value pathway of attention reportedly improves language model pretraining, and prior studies disagree on why. We argue and provide experimental evidence that such gates supply two different things that softmax attention lacks: abstention and noise filtering. The first is abstention, which allows an attention head to output nothing, bypassing the requirement that attention weights must sum to one. The second is noise filtering, which allows the value pathway of an attention head to suppress interference from superposed features in the residual stream. In our experiments in matched models from 10M to 350M parameters, we supply abstention through a learned per-head sink logit in the softmax and noise filtering through a gate on each value. We report three empirical findings. First, the benefit of abstention, measured as the reduction in validation loss relative to a matched baseline, declines as models grow, whereas the benefit of noise filtering increases with scale. In particular, abstention accounts for nearly all of the gain from gating at 10M and filtering for most of it at 350M. Second, the best model at every scale is the one with both primitives built in. Third, injecting controlled interference into the values a head reads confirms that the gate removes such interference, and reveals that each of the two gate forms we study has a characteristic blind spot. Supplying both primitives adds negligible parameters and remains compatible with the key-value cache.
2609.22005.paper_summary_zh: 報導指出，限制注意力的值通路可改善語言模型的預訓練，而先前的研究對此原因存在分歧。我們主張並提供實驗證據，表明這些閘門提供了 softmax 注意力所缺乏的兩樣東西：棄權和噪聲過濾。第一樣是棄權，這使得注意力頭可以不輸出任何東西，繞過注意力權重必須總和為一的要求。第二樣是噪聲過濾，這使得注意力頭的值通路能夠抑制來自殘差流中重疊特徵的干擾。在我們對 10M 到 350M 參數的匹配模型進行的實驗中，我們通過在 softmax 中學習的每個頭的 sink logit 提供棄權，並通過每個值上的閘門進行噪聲過濾。我們報告了三個實證發現。首先，棄權的好處，作為相對於匹配基線的驗證損失減少來衡量，隨著模型的增長而下降，而噪聲過濾的好處則隨著規模的增長而增加。特別是，棄權幾乎佔據了 10M 時閘門的所有增益，而在 350M 時則主要是過濾。第二，所有規模中最佳的模型都是內建這兩種原語的模型。第三，向頭讀取的值注入受控干擾證實了閘門移除了這種干擾，並顯示我們研究的兩種閘門形式各有特徵盲點。提供這兩種原語增加的參數微不足道，並且仍然與關鍵值緩存相容。
